meta.title: CMMS SaaS Server - Module Function Specification (Source of Truth)

conventions.build_rule: Modules are listed in strict build priority. A module may only call functions of modules with LOWER priority number, or communicate via events. Never import a later module.
conventions.request_context: Every domain service function takes ctx: RequestContext as first param. RequestContext = {org_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, role: Role, request_id: str, timezone: str|None}. HTTP routes build it from the verified JWT.
conventions.timestamps: ISO 8601 UTC; stored as timestamptz; user timezone applied at display only
conventions.pagination: Page[T] = {items: list[T], page: int, page_size: int, total: int}
conventions.events: Dot-delimited names; published via core.publish(); consumers never know producers
conventions.rls: All tenant queries run inside db.org_scoped_session(org_id)
conventions.routes: Functions marked 'route' are FastAPI endpoints under /api/v1 that validate input (Pydantic) then delegate to the same-named service function
conventions.tasks: Functions marked 'task' are Celery tasks registered via WORKER; 'beat' adds a schedule
conventions.soft_delete: No hard deletes of business records; deleted_at + is_active + lifecycle_status
conventions.audit: Functions marked 'audited' emit an audit event consumed by AUDIT module

types.HealthReport: {module: str, status: OK|DEGRADED|UNAVAILABLE, checks: [{name, status, latency_ms, detail}], ts: datetime}
types.TemplateSnapshot: {template_id: UUID, kind: workflow|checklist, code: str, items: list[WorkItemSnapshot], frozen_at: datetime}

modules.purpose: Identity, JWT lifecycle, password flows, RBAC engine. Feeds auth hook into API.

functions.sig: signup(email: EmailStr, password: str, timezone: str = 'UTC') -> User
functions.does: Validate password policy; hash; create unverified user; create single-use verification token (24h); send verify_email template; emit user.registered. Always 201 without leaking existence on duplicate (message generic).
Validate single-use time-limited token; mark user verified; emit user.verified. Invalid/expired -> 400.

functions.out: {access_token: JWT(15m), refresh_token set as HttpOnly Secure cookie(7d)}
functions.does: Verify credentials; block unverified or deactivated users; rate-limit via CACHE (strict); issue JWT claims {sub, organization_id, role, jti, exp}; issue refresh token family row; emit user.logged_in with ip/user_agent.
Rotation: invalidate presented token, issue new one in same family. REUSE detection (already-rotated token presented) -> invalidate entire family + force re-login.
Revoke current refresh token family; clear cookie.
If user exists: single-use reset token (30 min) + email. Constant response to prevent enumeration. Rate-limited.
Validate token; update hash; invalidate all sessions of user; mark token used; emit user.password_reset.
Return identity + effective role + permission list for UI gating.

functions.sig: issue_access_token(user_id: UUID, org_id: UUID, role: Role) -> str
functions.does: HS256 with CMMS_JWT_SECRET; claims sub/organization_id/role/jti/exp/iat. Used by login and MCP auth bridge.
Verify signature/exp/jti-not-revoked; return claims; raise Unauthorized on any failure. Shared by API hook and MCP.

functions.sig: hash_password(pw: str) -> str; verify_password(pw: str, hashed: str) -> bool
functions.does: Argon2id with tuned params; constant-time compare.
Min 10 chars, upper+lower+digit+symbol; reject breached list.

functions.sig: rbac_can(ctx: RequestContext, action: str, resource: str | None = None) -> bool
functions.does: Permission matrix (role x action) + object-level rules (e.g. only issuer accepts ticket). Deactivated users -> always False for new actions.
403 unless ctx.role in roles.
Middleware registered into API order 30: extract Bearer token -> verify_access_token -> store claims on request.state; public route list bypasses.
Revoke all refresh families + add active jti to revocation list (CACHE kv with TTL=access token lifetime).

functions.sig: change_role(ctx: RequestContext, user_id: UUID, new_role: Role) -> Membership
functions.does: Restricted role change; cannot grant SYS_ADMIN via org APIs; audited; emit user.role_changed.
Block new actions/assignments; retain history; invalidate sessions; audited; emit user.deactivated.
Delete expired verification/reset/refresh rows.

modules.purpose: Celery engine: task registry, beat registry, idempotency, retries, dead-letter, observability hooks.

functions.does: Broker+result from CACHE.broker_url(); JSON serializer; task time limits from config; worker signals wired to logging.

functions.sig: register_task(name: str, fn: Callable, retry: RetryPolicy | None = None) -> TaskHandle
functions.does: Wrap fn with logging (task id, status, duration), failure-reason persistence, retry policy. Called from each module's task contribution hook.

functions.sig: register_beat(name: str, task_name: str, schedule: Crontab | Interval) -> None
functions.does: Add to beat schedule registry; duplicate names raise.

functions.sig: dispatch(task_name: str, args: dict | None = None, countdown: int | None = None, idempotency_key: str | None = None) -> str
functions.does: If idempotency_key given, acquire CACHE lock(key, ttl); if already running/known, return existing task id instead of re-queueing. Core anti-duplicate mechanism for cycle generation.
Async result lookup + persisted failure reasons.
Cluster-wide exactly-one-at-a-time for beat jobs via CACHE.lock. If not acquired, skip silently.

functions.sig: retry_with_backoff(task, exc: Exception, base: float = 2.0, max_retries: int = 5) -> None
functions.does: Exponential backoff (base^n + jitter); on exhaustion route to dead-letter queue and store failure reason for inspection.

functions.out: Page of {task_id, name, error, failed_at, payload_ref}
functions.does: Admin inspection of dead-letter entries (exposed via OBSERVABILITY admin route).
At start(), call each module's register_tasks()/register_beat() contribution hooks.
Graceful shutdown: let running tasks finish, revoke queued, close broker connections.

Status SUSPENDED; no work order generation; calendar triggers pause; emit cycle.suspended; audited.

Idempotency: CACHE.lock per cycle + unique(cycle_id, period_key). Failures recorded + emit cycle.eval_failed.

JWT path uses AUTH.verify_access_token; API-key path looks up scoped key bound to one organization_id + one role. SYS_ADMIN REJECTED unconditionally. Unauthenticated calls blocked before any tool/resource.

Register read resources: cmms://assets/zones, cmms://assets/systems, cmms://assets/service-points/{id}, .../history, .../manuals, cmms://cycles/{id}, cmms://workflows/{id}, cmms://checklists/{id}, cmms://work-orders, cmms://work-orders/{id}, cmms://tickets, cmms://tickets/{id}, cmms://reports/kpis, cmms://notifications. Each maps to the owning module's port with org scope + role check.

Register write tools (each wraps a domain port, NO re-implementation): Asset(MANAGER): create_zone, update_zone, clone_zone, decommission_zone, create_system, update_system, create_service_point, update_service_point, generate_qr, decommission_service_point. Cycles(MANAGER): create_cycle, update_cycle, suspend_cycle, activate_cycle, assign_workflow_to_cycle, assign_checklist_to_cycle, set_cycle_flag. Counters(OPERATOR,MANAGER): log_operating_hours, log_operation_count, reset_counter. WorkOrders(MAINTENANCE,MANAGER): acknowledge_work_order, reject_work_order, snooze_work_order, update_work_order_item_status, record_measurement, submit_work_order_signature, add_work_order_comment. Tickets(OPERATOR,MANAGER,MAINTENANCE): create_repair_ticket, submit_ticket_report, submit_ticket_feedback, accept_ticket, escalate_ticket. Authoring(MANAGER): create_workflow, create_checklist, add_workflow_item, add_checklist_item, ai_generate_checklist. AI(any authed): ask_manual_assistant. Reporting(MANAGER,REPORTER): get_kpi_dashboard, export_report. Ops: batch_rollback.

functions.does: MANDATORY gates: set_cycle_flag(STOP_UNTIL_COMPLETE), decommission_zone, decommission_service_point, clone_zone, create_repair_ticket(priority=CRITICAL). Execution proceeds only via confirm(token) presented to a human. CMMS_MCP__CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED=true default.

functions.does: Every write tool accepts dry_run; validate inputs, compute side-effects, return expected result WITHOUT persisting.
Via CACHE.allow: write tools max 30/min/session; AI-assist tools max 10/min/session; plus global REST limiter inheritance.
Session-hour caps: <=50 work orders, <=50 tickets; exceed -> quota error.

functions.sig: safety_flag_guard(session: Session, tool: str, args: dict) -> None
functions.does: MCP agent cannot clear/downgrade a STOP_UNTIL_COMPLETE flag set by a human; escalation only. Raise on violation.
Undo last N session writes within window (default 5 min, CMMS_MCP__ROLLBACK_WINDOW_S) ONLY if no human modified those records since; transactional.

functions.sig: audit_call(session: Session, tool: str, args: dict, result: str) -> None
functions.does: AUD.record with actor_type=MCP_AGENT, actor_id=session/key id, action=tool, input_hash=sha256(payload), ip/user-agent of orchestrator. Powers AI Activity Log.
Transport liveness + auth bridge self-test + downstream port reachability; served at /health on HTTP transport.
